# Syntax Matrix

Paragraph with `inline code`, [documentation](../../../../../docs/README.md), and [internal file](../prose/content.md).

> Blockquotes should remain blockquotes.

1. Ordered item
   - Nested bullet
   - Another nested bullet
2. Second ordered item

- [ ] Task item
- [x] Completed task
